author: Latha
content: I understand .. needless to say everyone will be under that situation .. But had it never happened to you that you know the solution yourself but then when someone explains you in a better way .. you realize and think about it?? It does.. Well, for me it did! When friends confide something .. the latter does not switch into "I am the philosopher" mode jus because they have confided.  It's jus that we also have been through those situations, and we can't see our dearest to be sad and dull.. It's because their pain starts becoming your pain.. And to ease them up we do certain things.. while one turn serious and start explaining things which they are already aware.. the others crack a joke and try to lighten things...
